title: Job: task-based recruitment pattern, Scamwatch warning
input: You will complete sets of tasks, set up a cryptocurrency account, and may be paid a small sum of money to build your trust. Then, to unlock the next set of tasks and earn your commission you will be told to ‘top up’ your account with your own money. Once you pay this money, you will never get it back.

title: Rental: payment before viewing, Action Fraud warning
input: The scams work by offering to let property in prime areas at below market rents and asking for deposits, or in some cases full payment upfront in order to secure the property prior to visiting it, or to prove they have the money in order to rent for the duration.
